name: hex
title: Hex
description: Control Hex dictation and browse saved dictations, captures, and meetings. Requires Hex 3.4.0 or later
author: tim_gailey

commands.name: toggle-dictation
commands.title: Toggle Dictation
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Start a dictation, or stop it and paste the transcript. Opens Hex if it isn't running

commands.name: start-dictation
commands.title: Start Dictation
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Start a dictation that runs until you stop it. Opens Hex if it isn't running

commands.name: stop-dictation
commands.title: Stop Dictation
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Stop the Hex dictation in progress and paste the transcript

commands.name: cancel-dictation
commands.title: Cancel Dictation
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Discard the Hex dictation in progress without transcribing or pasting it

commands.name: paste-last-dictation
commands.title: Paste Last Dictation
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Paste your most recent Hex dictation into the active app

commands.name: copy-last-dictation
commands.title: Copy Last Dictation
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Copy your most recent Hex dictation to the clipboard

commands.name: search-history
commands.title: Search Dictation History
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Search the dictations Hex has kept, then paste or copy one

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: What Enter does on a dictation

commands.name: browse-captures
commands.title: Browse Captures
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Browse the screenshots, screen recordings, and annotations Hex has saved, then paste, copy, or open one

commands.name: take-screenshot
commands.title: Take Screenshot
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Open Hex's screenshot picker to copy and save a screenshot. Requires Labs › Screenshots

commands.name: toggle-annotation
commands.title: Toggle Annotation
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Start a Hex annotation that records your screen with drawing and narration, or stop the one in progress

commands.name: toggle-annotation-sending
commands.title: Toggle Sending Annotations to OpenCode
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Choose whether Hex sends annotations to OpenCode or only saves and copies them. Off also stops Hex's OpenCode warning

commands.name: search-meetings
commands.title: Search Meetings
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Browse the meetings Hex has recorded and read or copy their transcripts

commands.name: toggle-meeting-recording
commands.title: Toggle Meeting Recording
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Start recording a meeting in Hex, or stop and transcribe the one in progress

commands.name: manage-vocabulary
commands.title: Manage Vocabulary
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: View, add, edit, and remove vocabulary terms

commands.name: add-vocabulary-term
commands.title: Add Vocabulary Term
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Add a word or name, with the misspellings Hex should correct

commands.name: switch-model
commands.title: Switch Model
commands.subtitle: Hex
commands.description: Select or download a transcription model
